patch.value: Overlap audit: core SDK context intents own declarative projections and core read-output sessions own cross-read references and accounting. Existing context-evidence ranks criterion evidence, context-freshness detects source changes, and context-handoff emits handoffs; sibling pm-brief summarizes tracker context, pm-review evaluates review evidence, pm-memory stores memories, and pm-rlm orchestrates inference. None binds caller-declared mandatory tracker fields to all four explicit task phases with fail-closed budgeting and per-field phase-switch explanations. This feature composes existing SDK reads, intents, omission receipts and sessions. Phase selection grants no agent authority and performs no lifecycle transition.
Keep mandatory task-phase context fields and explain phase switches
Explicit investigation, implementation, review and handoff requirements over authoritative SDK field reads, with lossless compact packets and unchanged SDK session references.
Four phase fixtures preserve every mandatory field or refuse; unrelated fields are omitted with restore selectors; one phase switch reuses unchanged SDK session references.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Plan: one strict bounded request schema, typed SDK and context-phase command, all-or-refuse mandatory fields, exact omission restoration, SDK sessions keyed by item/field/value so changed projections cannot reuse stale facts. Stateless caller-carried session input; no new tracker mutation, import/sync writer, journal, lease or shared checkpoint. Validate four phases, seeded 500-sequence SDK-read model, extreme input/output values, installed no-git CLI, behavioral revert proof and read-only committed public snapshot. Local targeted tests/typecheck/docstrings; npm and Bun full gates in CI at unchanged thresholds. CLI registry reports 2026.10.25; retain package SDK pin 2026.10.23 per queue rules.

value.author: codex
value.text: Implementation uses SDK intent composition/resolution, SDK omission receipts and SDK session suppression/accounting over the existing cache-free freshness reader. Field facts bind target item, field and current SDK JSON value; new phase fields cannot alias older projections. Full metadata fixtures exposed SDK optional properties with undefined values in linked files/docs; accept only ordinary JSON omission of optional object properties, retain exact whitespace and relationships, reject sparse arrays/nonfinite values. Reference model reads SDK get output through standard JSON transport, with no handwritten normalization. Installed CLI testing also caught camelCase option normalization; all command overrides now accept the host-normalized keys.
